title: Updated - my idle game (WIP) based on data centers, Data Campus
author: Careless-Flower6059
selftext:
Hey all,

[https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus](https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus)

I posted this idle game around 7-10 days ago and thank you to all that played it!

AI Usage: I used generative AI allthrought out the development of the game, including the visuals. I tried to make the visuals as less 'Claude' as possible, but if I ever consider releasing, will most likely work with an artist.

After some few testers and the great feedback I got from here, I've updated the game a bit (you can find the devlog here if you're interested: [https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus/devlog/1702753/big-update-a-clearer-tutorial-the-weekly-league-and-corporations](https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus/devlog/1702753/big-update-a-clearer-tutorial-the-weekly-league-and-corporations) ).

I tried to make everything clearer through the tutorial and small nudges throughout the game without giving away too much, let me know what you think, any and all comments/feedback are greatly welcome, prefer as honest comments as possible.

Hope you enjoy!
